title: How to Set Up Your Solana Development Environment | Blockchain Development Introduction
description:
Want to start building on Solana? In this video, I’ll show you how to set up your Solana development environment from scratch on your computer.                                                              
                                                                          
You’ll learn how to install the core tools needed for Solana development, including Rust, Solana CLI, Anchor, and additional testing tools like Surfpool so you can start building, testing, and deploying Solana programs locally.                                     
                                                                          
In this tutorial, you’ll learn:                                        
   - How to install Rust for Solana development                           
   - How to install and configure Solana CLI                              
   - How to install Anchor framework                                      
   - How to set up Surfpool and other Solana testing tools                
   - How to prepare your machine for building Solana smart contracts      
   - The essential developer environment for Solana beginners             
                                                                          
 This video is perfect for:                                             
   - Beginners getting started with Solana development                    
   - Developers moving from Web2 to Web3                                  
   - Anyone who wants to build Solana smart contracts with Anchor         
   - Developers looking for a clean Solana local setup                    
                                                                          
Topics covered:                                                        
Solana development setup, Solana CLI install, Anchor install, Rust install, Surfpool setup, Solana smart contract development, Solana developer tools, Solana environment setup, Anchor framework tutorial, Solana for beginners                                         
                                                                          
 If this video helped you set up your Solana dev environment, like, subscribe, and comment what Solana project you want to build next.     
                                                                          
 #Solana #Anchor #RustLang #Web3Development #BlockchainDevelopment      
 #SolanaCLI #SmartContracts #CryptoDev
